event.summary: Investigation of the captured EOG dataset (cutoff 1794830400) identified one ongoing pump_failure at DELTA/α/STATION-1, detected at onset_unix 1794826800 with ~1.45h countdown. Station-2 pump is healthy. The automatic_shutdown plan (plan_id 44fce30d-34b0-49f2-9522-69cca41734e7) shuts down STATION-1 after 5208s elapsed, resulting in total lost revenue of $11726 with zero truck cost. The plan was independently validated via validation_id validation-5a4658abeaa2748747c1f282d4bfafd198951e31b5d7d056684c9c670ad12116 (eog-native-seconds-0.1.1). No other pump failures exist; the no-action baseline (empty truck_jobs/well_shut_ins) was evaluated and validated as feasible but not optimal. Limitations: detection is partial coverage, stale evidence for some pre-onset readings, and the validator uses a rational method distinct from the native evaluator.

assumptions: Onset estimate uses the first observed fault feedback; it is not a hidden event label.
Pump delivery is assumed zero after compatible fault feedback; raw measured flow is retained.
limitations: Inspection timing/recovery is experimental and remains unqualified on retained official causal cuts.
No calibrated confidence intervals or fault probabilities are supplied.

assumptions: Synthetic fixed-rate failed-pump forecast ends at each causal expected repair deadline.
All current pump failures share each system's whole snapshot fleet; prior scenario commitments are not modeled.

The facility inflow meter is authoritative for total future inflow. Per-well contributions are allocated in proportion to current measured well water; this explicit reconciliation retains the raw captured evidence.
Automatic shutdown never restarts wells before repair, including after a later pickup.
Onset estimate uses the first observed fault feedback; it is not a hidden event label.
Pump delivery is assumed zero after compatible fault feedback; raw measured flow is retained.
limitations: Fixed-rate response evaluation is not hydraulic simulation, independent validation, search or a calibrated uncertainty estimate.
All current failures must be declared; subset response contexts and evolving prior fleet commitments are not yet supported.

objective: Investigate the current synthetic network, identify supported risks, and compare useful responses at low modeled cost. Select a response only with independent validation of the exact plan. Once the selected response has its own completed validation, finish with those exact returned plan and validation IDs rather than repeating identical validation calls. Choose tools from the evidence and keep advice for human review.
